STEP 1 - Scene: This is a snack of whole almonds (roasted or plain) in a heap on a white, leaf-shaped plate. The photo is taken from above at a slight angle.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The plate is roughly 26 cm across at its longest undistorted width, so I treat it as a dinner plate. Area is about 3.14 x 13^2 = 530 cm^2. The almonds are the only food on this plate. The food at the bottom-right edge is on a different plate and is excluded.

STEP 3 - Items: One item, whole almonds, about 55 pieces visible.

STEP 4 - Area: The almond heap covers about 20% of the plate, roughly 106 cm^2.

STEP 5 - Volume: Pile height is about 1.2 cm on average, so 106 cm^2 x 1.2 cm ≈ 127 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Whole nuts have a bulk density of about 0.5 g/ml. 127 ml x 0.5 ≈ 64 g. Cross-check: 55 almonds x ~1.2 g each ≈ 66 g, which agrees.

STEP 7 - Energy: Almonds are about 580 kcal per 100 g. 64 g x 5.8 ≈ 370 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 65 g of almonds (roughly a small handful) at about 370 kcal is plausible for what is visible.
